name: ts-star
description: Web Standards Datastar SDK for server-driven TypeScript applications

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:example:counter: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:counter
scripts.check:example:hono-counter: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:hono-counter
scripts.check:example:hono-live-counter: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:hono-live-counter
scripts.check:example:live-counter: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:live-counter
scripts.check:example:search: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:search
scripts.check:example:todo-sync: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:todo-sync
scripts.check:example:tsx-counter: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:tsx-counter
scripts.check:example:validation-form: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:example:validation-form
scripts.check:examples: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:examples
scripts.dev:counter: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js counter
scripts.dev:hono-counter: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js hono-counter
scripts.dev:hono-live-counter: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js hono-live-counter
scripts.dev:live-counter: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js live-counter
scripts.dev:search: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js search
scripts.dev:tsx-counter: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js tsx-counter
scripts.dev:validation-form: pnpm run build && node dist/examples/dev-server.js validation-form
scripts.test:examples: vitest run test/example-counter.test.ts test/example-tsx-counter.test.ts test/search-example.test.ts test/live-counter-example.test.ts test/validation-form-example.test.ts test/hono-counter-example.test.ts test/hono-live-counter-example.test.ts test/todo-sync-example.test.ts
